description: This file contains test cases for a FastAPI application, utilizing pytest and fastapi's TestClient. It includes fixtures for client setup, parameterized tests for API endpoints, and schema validation tests.

classes.name: TestClient
classes.description: A test client from FastAPI used to simulate HTTP requests.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports the module based on parametrization and returns a test client instance.

methods.name: test_get(path, cookie, expected_status, expected_response, client: TestClient)
methods.description: Parameterized test function that verifies GET requests and response correctness with different cookies and paths.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test function that retrieves and validates the OpenAPI schema generated by the FastAPI app.
